payload.core_mechanism_summary: Generate all 4-digit numbers with distinct digits, then filter by consistency with given bulls and cows clues until one candidate remains.
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates all possible 4-digit numbers (leading zero allowed) with distinct digits, which is effectively a permutation enumeration of 4 digits from 0-9. It uses a set to store candidates and iteratively filters based on clue compatibility. No backtracking or branch-and-bound is used.
